learnings: Measure before optimising: `cProfile` shows which functions consume the time.
`timeit.repeat` with the minimum gives a stable comparison of alternatives.
The biggest wins come from algorithms and data structures (set/Counter instead of list scans), not micro-tweaks.
pitfalls: An optimisation is only valid if it returns the same result – every fast path is checked against the slow one.
